caption: The drawing features detailed illustrations of ornamental wooden furniture components and a sofa outline. At the upper left, there is a colored depiction of a carved wooden crest with intricate scrollwork and a central rose motif, highlighted by a green horizontal band beneath the carving. Below and parallel to the upper element, there is a similar ornate wooden panel with swirling leaf patterns and a green strip above it. In the center of the composition is a lightly sketched outline of a sofa, showing a latticed backrest, curved arms, and ornate apron, suggesting the placement of the carved elements. On the right side, there is a side view rendering of a carved wooden sofa leg featuring decorative scrolls, a floral embellishment, and a ball-like foot at the bottom. The leg is shaded to indicate dimensionality, with a dark section showing the attachment point. The drawing uses shades of brown and green for the carved elements and plain black and gray for the sketched sofa and shadows. The artist's signature, "R. Stewart," appears at the lower right corner of the page. The background is plain, uncolored paper.
title: Carvings of a Sofa
